correctness.rationale: Cubic degree at half filling gives H=15−4e(S), where e(S) counts edges induced by the plus spins, so the accepted rate-one exchanges are exactly adjacent opposite-spin swaps with nondecreasing e(S). The fresh replay constructs GP(5,2) as the Petersen graph, scans all 252 five-sets and all eligible edges using the Hamiltonian, and computes full forward/reverse reachability. Energy counts at (−5,−1,3,7) are (12,120,60,60). Every microstate at those respective energies has target-energy census empty, {−1:4}, {−5:1,−1:4}, or {−1:2,3:4,7:5}. The SCCs are twelve ground singletons, one 120-state excited SCC, sixty energy-3 singletons, and one energy-7 SCC of 60 states, with only the first two groups closed. Girth five also implies that induced subgraphs on five vertices with five edges are five-cycles, and ones with four edges are acyclic and connected. At energies 3 and 7 the ground hitting probabilities solve p3=1/5 and 6p7=4p3; expected closed-class entrance times solve m3=1/5 and 6m7=1+4m3. Neutral terms cancel because these solutions are constant within each energy. Closure as well as a positive downward hazard on both transient levels ensures almost-sure entrance and uniqueness of the finite Dirichlet solutions. The exact uniform averages give 8/63 toward ground, 55/63 toward the active class, and 5/42 mean entrance in rate-one edge-clock units; recurrent starts have zero entrance time.
